units: <cite ref="Gittin 68a:5">Gitt. 68ᵃ</cite> (expl. <he>שדה ושדות</he>, <cite ref="Ecclesiastes 2:8">Koh. II, 8</cite>) <he>הכי תרגימו שידה ושידתין</he> they translate it thus, demoness and demonesses, i.e. all sorts of female demons; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 968:1">Yalk. Koh. 968</cite> <he>שדה ושדתין</he>. Gitt. l. c. <he>אייתי ש׳ וש׳ וכ׳</he> let the demons come, and press them against one another, perchance they know; <he>אייתי שידה ושידתי וכ׳</he> he summoned the demons &c.
